final: WITH g AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.SEX,'(missing)') AS sex, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Examination e LEFT JOIN Patient p ON p.ID=e.ID GROUP BY COALESCE(p.SEX,'(missing)')), t AS (SELECT SUM(n) AS tot, AVG(n) AS av FROM g) SELECT g.sex AS sex, g.n AS n_examined, 1.0*g.n/t.tot AS share, NULL AS avg_excess_over_avg FROM g, t UNION ALL SELECT 'ABOVE_AVERAGE_COMBINED', SUM(g.n), AVG(1.0*g.n/t.tot), AVG(g.n - t.av) FROM g, t WHERE g.n > t.av
